title: A Model Companion for Abelian Lattice-Ordered Groups with a Valuation
summary: An abelian lattice-ordered group, or abelian $\ell$-group, is an abelian group equipped with a compatible lattice ordering. In this paper, we introduce two multi-sorted extensions of abelian lattice-ordered groups inspired by the zero-set maps for continuous functions into R. We demonstrate that this expansion is equivalent to equipping G with a spectral subspace X of $\ell$-Spec(G), along with the map sending $a \in G$ to $V(a \wedge 0) \cap X$.
